title: Figure in layers
description: « Étapes » drawn as one figure that assembles itself as it scrolls into view: figureImage first, then each step's image, a layer drawn over it one after the other (fading, sweeping round, dropping in, wiped from the top), and labels set over the figure at given positions (words, or harbour names written from a point at any angle, as on a chart, or someone's words in a bubble). Square or wide, full size or compact beside the reading column. The steps' titles and texts name the layers for text views and exports; the figure's alt describes it whole. Without scroll-driven animations, with reduced motion, or set to show at once (still), it shows complete.
instructions: Draw every layer in the same frame as figureImage (generators); mark the layers decorative and describe the whole figure in figureAlt (or, without figureImage, give the one layer its alt). Each step's title names what its layer adds in a few words, its text says it in one sentence. Labels are words: keep them short, and place them in % of the figure (x from the left, y from the top).

presentation.description: scroll: the figure assembles as the page scrolls it into view (the only presentation of this style).

figure.description: build: each step's image is a layer drawn over figureImage.

reveal.description: fade: appears; sweep: drawn round like a compass; drop: falls into place; wipe: drawn from top to bottom.

baseReveal.description: How figureImage appears (see the steps' reveal).

still.description: true: shown complete at once (a figure at the top of a page), without assembling as it scrolls.

ratio.description: Width ÷ height of the figure and of every layer (1: square; 1.96 for the chart on its skin).

size.description: full: as large as the block allows; compact: small enough to see whole with the text around it.

x.description: Horizontal position, in % of the figure.

y.description: Vertical position, in % of the figure.

tone.description: ink: small capitals; rubric: small capitals in red; italic: an aside; name and name-rubric: a harbour name as written on a chart, in black or red, starting at its point (x, y) and running at its angle; bubble and bubble-below: someone's words in a speech bubble above or below its point, the tail pointing at it (angle ignored).

angle.description: Rotation of the label in degrees, clockwise (90: reads downwards, along a river; beyond ±90 a name reads upside down, as on a chart read from every side).
